issues.description: The return type of Stock.getStockIngredients differs between the template and the solution. The template's Stock.getStockIngredients returns java.util.List<StockIngredient> while the solution's Stock.getStockIngredients returns StockIngredient[]. This discrepancy can confuse students about which type to use when interacting with the stock and may cause compilation or API-usage issues when following examples or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type of getStockIngredients across template and solution. Either change the template to return StockIngredient[] (matching the solution), or change the solution to return List<StockIngredient> (matching the template). Update any example code or documentation to use the chosen type consistently.
